outline.chapter_title: Introduction to Mathematical Reasoning with Large Language Models
outline.description: Provides the motivation, challenges, and recent progress in applying LLMs to mathematical reasoning, setting the stage for DeepSeekMath.
subtopics: Why mathematical reasoning is hard for LLMs
Benchmark landscape: MATH, GSM8K, CMATH, etc.

outline.description: Introduces the family of models (Base, Instruct, RL) and how they are built on a code‑oriented foundation.
subtopics: Training stages: pre‑training, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning
Comparison with prior models (Minerva, Llemma, etc.)

outline.description: Describes the end‑to‑end pipeline for harvesting 120 B math tokens from Common Crawl and why this data matters.
subtopics: FastText classifier training and iterative refinement
Domain‑level analysis and manual URL annotation
Deduplication, token statistics, and multilingual coverage

outline.chapter_title: Quality Evaluation of the DeepSeekMath Corpus
outline.description: Shows how to assess corpus quality by training small models on different corpora and measuring downstream performance.
subtopics: Experimental setup (1.3 B model, 150 B tokens)
Few‑shot CoT evaluation on eight benchmarks

outline.description: Details the full pre‑training regime for the base model and presents its capabilities.
subtopics: Data mixture proportions (math, code, natural language)
Optimizer settings, learning‑rate schedule, batch size
General language understanding (MMLU, BBH) and coding (HumanEval, MBPP)

outline.description: Explains how chain‑of‑thought, program‑of‑thought and tool‑integrated data are curated and used to fine‑tune the base model.
\nsubtopics: "Curating 776 K instruction examples" – sources and annotation workflow
"Evaluation of DeepSeekMath‑Instruct on zero/few shot benchmarks"

outline.chapter_title: "Group Relative Policy Optimization" – A New RL Algorithm
outline.\ndescription: "Derives GRPO from PPO, explains its memory advantage and group‑based baseline estimation."
\nsubtopics: "Group sampling strategy and relative advantage computation"
"Iterative GRPO with replayed reward model updates"
